trigger.description: The scale envelope observes a cold or partially rebuilt cache/index posture that is moving toward a warm state. Command SLOs may be temporarily slower, but the posture is not yet thrashing or blocked.
setup_commands: ee remember 'scale warmup rule' --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule
trigger.invocation: Emit ee.scale_envelope.v1 with pageCacheWalPosture.cacheState=warming or an index subsystem state=rebuilding while command SLOs remain within the warming budget.

expected_emission.repair_contains: Allow the warmup to complete or prewarm
expected_emission.repair_string: Allow the warmup to complete, or run the recommended cache/index prewarm action before measuring steady-state SLOs.
